hero.title: Two founders, one standard: AI that actually works.
hero.description: NEXAI isn't a faceless software company. Behind every project it's us in person, Maximilian Trenk and Jason Brian Merklein, with a team from Frankenhardt building digital employees that hold up in real operations.

mission.title: We wanted AI that keeps its promise.
mission.body: When we started NEXAI, we kept seeing the same thing: impressive AI demos that take nothing off your plate in everyday work. We set out to do it differently. We, Maximilian and Jason, build digital employees that measurably help from day one: reliable, secure and tailored precisely to each company's processes. We'd rather build one solution that truly runs than ten that just look good. Today we're a growing team, but our standard hasn't changed: technology that takes work off people and gives businesses a real edge.

items.title: Outcomes over hype
items.description: We deliver measurable value, not buzzwords.
